verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform inherently supports recurring payroll schedules (regular payroll cadences, multi-location schedule support) and webhook events that can trigger downstream automation, which partially satisfies 'recurring workflows.' However, there is no evidence of an AI-native job/workflow scheduler, cron-style automation trigger, or agent-configurable recurring task system beyond the built-in payroll cadence. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/orchestration API for AI agents, support for arbitrary recurring workflows beyond payroll runs, and any AI-specific automation-scheduling documentation.
